pages.text: $(l)Steel$()$(li)Steel takes a lot of alloy smelters: one player ran four on it and very few on anything else.

$(l)Brain fluid lines need careful planning$()$(li)Ensure neutral spirit is available before starting brain fluid production—it halts otherwise.$(li)Use two 10k recipes to reach the next tier (e.g., 10k → 10k → 100k), not a direct 100k jump—it doubles resource needs.
$(li)Upgrade fluid throughput early: replace EnderIO conduits with lasers for faster brain juice transfer.

$(l)Boss drops and other setups$()$(li)Anihilation planes may break tanks and drop items—use ME Interface + storage bus or XNet sensor for reliable fluid extraction.$(li)Fake players do not trigger the World Corrupting Meatball boss drop—use real players or passive farming.

$(li)A Scorching Heat Pickaxe converts boss statues to Divine Shards efficiently, despite seeming counterintuitive.$(li)Brain passive setups consume significant space—plan extra platforms or reorganize to accommodate future passives.
